metric_type.description: The kind of series the receiver dropped.

description: This receiver implements the [Prometheus Remote Write 2.0 protocol](https://prometheus.io/docs/specs/prw/remote_write_spec_2_0/).

feature_gates.description: When enabled, the prometheusremotewritereceiver will disable the splitting of the job label by '/' to derive service.namespace and service.name, instead mapping the entire job string to service.name.

name: prometheusremotewritereceiver

receiver_prometheusremotewrite_dropped_s.description: Number of classic histogram and summary series dropped because the receiver does not support them. Their samples are still reported as written.

receiver_prometheusremotewrite_resource_.description: Number of job/instance entries evicted from the resource metrics cache because it was full.
